title: CFexpress / SD / SSD not detected
fullDescription:
Pocket 6K/6K G2/6K Pro and URSA/URSA Mini require certified CFexpress Type B, SD UHS-II, or USB-C SSD for BRAW at higher bitrates. Uncertified media often fails at 6K/12K rates.

Check the Blackmagic media compatibility list.

fixSteps.title: Use certified media
fixSteps.instruction: Check Blackmagic Design approved SSD/CFexpress list for your body.

fixSteps.title: Secure USB-C SSD
fixSteps.instruction: Use Blackmagic mounting plate or locking USB-C cable.

faq.a: Yes, use Blackmagic's approved list; Samsung T7/T5 fail above certain bitrates.

title: Media cannot sustain bitrate
shortDescription: BRAW write speed exceeded media's sustained rate.
fullDescription: Even certified SSDs degrade. If dropped frames appear, verify with Blackmagic Speed Test, reformat media, or lower BRAW compression (e.g., 5:1 -> 8:1).

fixSteps.title: Lower BRAW ratio
fixSteps.instruction: Use Q5 or 8:1 to reduce write demand.

faq.a: Yes, format after each major project for reliable sustained writes.

title: UI hang requires forced reboot
fullDescription: Pocket cinema cameras occasionally hang after firmware glitches or corrupted media. Remove battery; with NP-F970 kit, detach external power too.

fixSteps.title: Remove suspect media
fixSteps.instruction: Boot without the card/SSD to isolate.

whenToCallPro: If hang recurs after firmware reinstall.

title: LP-E6 drains in under 45 minutes
shortDescription: Stock Pocket battery life is very short.
fullDescription: Pocket 6K uses Canon LP-E6 style batteries that last ~45 minutes. Use LP-E6NH or NP-F970 external kit for production runtimes. Body firmware v7.9+ adds better battery reporting.

fixSteps.title: Add NP-F970 dummy battery kit
fixSteps.instruction: Blackmagic and third-party offer full-day runtime kits.

videoSearchQuery: Blackmagic Pocket short battery life fix

faq.a: Pocket 6K Pro supports USB-PD; useful for powering from V-mount.

title: External monitor/recorder not receiving image
shortDescription: HDMI handshake fails or cable not recognized.
fullDescription: Pocket 6K Pro's full-size HDMI is reliable; Pocket 6K/4K micro-HDMI is fragile. Cable quality and port seating matter. Clean HDMI output setting must match recorder input.

fixSteps.title: Check cable + port
fixSteps.instruction: Try another high-speed HDMI cable and recorder port.

videoSearchQuery: Blackmagic Pocket HDMI no signal fix

faq.a: Use HDMI cable clamp or cage with port support to prevent port damage.

title: Continuous AF not supported
shortDescription: Pocket cinema bodies do not have continuous AF.
fullDescription: Pocket 4K/6K/6K Pro support only one-shot AF (tap to focus). Continuous AF is not a feature; users coming from mirrorless often mistake this for a fault.
symptoms: Tapping focus button does nothing continuous

fixSteps.title: Use tap-to-focus
fixSteps.instruction: Tap subject on touchscreen for single AF lock.

fixSteps.title: Follow focus or Tilta Nucleus
fixSteps.instruction: For cine-style focus pulls, use motorized follow focus.

faq.a: Same limitation — cinematic, not consumer AF.

title: URSA Mini fan ramps during recording
shortDescription: Fan is audible in onboard audio.
fullDescription: URSA Mini Pro 4.6K G2 and 12K fans can ramp under load, bleeding into onboard mic. Set Fan Setting to Quiet during takes, or use external audio.
whenToCallPro: If fan noise unusually loud or grinding.

faq.a: Blackmagic rates Quiet for moderate ambient; monitor temps.

title: Timecode not matching slate or other cameras
shortDescription: Internal TC drifts from external generator.
fullDescription: On multi-cam shoots, internal TC oscillators drift. Jam-sync via Tentacle Sync or Deity TC-1, or use the URSA's external TC input.

fixSteps.title: Jam-sync before each shoot
fixSteps.instruction: Use Tentacle/Deity TC box on the 3.5mm audio in.

videoSearchQuery: Blackmagic timecode drift Tentacle Sync fix

faq.a: Free run recommended for multi-cam; record run for single-cam.

title: EF / L-mount / Nikon Z adapter communication fault
fullDescription: EF-mount Pocket 6K requires communicating EF lenses for aperture/focus control. Metabones or third-party adapters on Pocket 6K Pro / Cinema Camera 6K (L-mount) can fail handshake.

faq.a: Manual cine lenses don't require electronic contacts.

title: Corrupted BRAW file
fullDescription: A BRAW clip interrupted by power loss may only be partially written. Blackmagic Media Tool and Resolve can often still ingest. Pair with proper shutdown and quality media to prevent.

fixSteps.title: Use Blackmagic Media Tool
fixSteps.instruction: Ingest BRAW clips via the tool to rebuild index.

fixSteps.title: Try Resolve force reconform
fixSteps.instruction: In Media, right-click > Clip Attributes > Force.

whenToCallPro: For commercial data recovery if critical take lost.

faq.a: Yes — never yank batteries during record.
